items.title: CATL and Alfen strike 5GWh sodium-ion BESS deal
items.summary: System integrator Alfen and Chinese battery giant CATL have <cite index="1-3">struck a 5GWh partnership for sodium-ion BESS deployments in Europe</cite>. The agreement signals accelerating commercial confidence in sodium-ion chemistry as a cost-competitive, safer alternative to lithium-ion for utility-scale European storage projects.

items.title: Google breaks ground on huge Arkansas solar-storage site
items.summary: Google and partner Cypress Creek Energy broke ground on the Steel River Energy Center in Mississippi County, Arkansas, described as <cite index="15-2,15-3">the largest solar facility in the United States and the largest solar and storage project across Google's global portfolio to date</cite>. The first two phases alone will add <cite index="15-5">1 GW of solar capacity and 1.9 GWh of battery storage</cite> to power Google's regional data centers, with the company also funding an $8 million local community fund.

items.title: Frontier Power converts 920MWh Texas BESS portfolio
items.summary: Frontier Power USA exercised its selection right to bring four Texas battery projects—Blanquilla, Aransas Pass, Nash and Wallis—onto its platform, representing <cite index="11-2">approximately 230 MW / 920 MWh of battery energy storage capacity</cite> expected to use Eos Energy's long-duration Z3 batteries. Closing depends on the successful completion of Eos's previously announced rights offering.
